senses: to gather, receive, remove, gather in
to gather (an individual into company of others)
to gather and take away, remove, withdraw
to be gathered to one's fathers
to be brought in or into (association with others)
to be taken away, removed, perish

strongs.def: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
strongs.kjv: assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), [idiom] generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, [idiom] surely, take (away, into, up), [idiom] utterly, withdraw
